title: Monogenic even sextic trinomials and their Galois groups
summary: Let $f(x)=x^6+Ax^{2k}+B\in {\mathbb Z}[x]$, with $A\ne 0$ and $k\in \{1,2\}$. We say that $f(x)$ is {\em monogenic} if $f(x)$ is irreducible over ${\mathbb Q}$ and $\{1,θ,θ^2,θ^3,θ^4,θ^{5}\}$ is a basis for the ring of integers of ${\mathbb Q}(θ)$, where $f(θ)=0$. For each value of $k$ and each possible Galois group $G$ of $f(x)$ over ${\mathbb Q}$, we use a theorem of Jakhar, Khanduja and Sangwan to give explicit descriptions of all monogenic trinomials $f(x)$ having Galois group $G$.
